events.survey.walk: The queen walks over the soil, comparing nearby water and heat sensed locally.
events.survey.choose: The queen chose a visited point and starts digging. The surface reading does not guarantee the chamber’s future climate.
events.colony.alates: The colony invested in a princess and a male for the next flight.
events.colony.alateDeath: An alate did not survive until the next flight window.
events.colony.daughter: Colony {v0}: a daughter of colony {v1} took off to found another nest.
events.colony.food: Colony {v0}: low reserves. Workers need to collect food.
events.brood.nanitics: The first nanitics take over foraging. The colony now depends on outside food.
events.ecology.adopted: A caterpillar with compatible odor was adopted in the nursery.
events.founding.semiclaustral: The shelter is ready. The queen must forage outside to raise the first brood.
events.founding.claustral: The shelter is ready. The queen raises the first brood with her maternal reserves.
events.flight.start: Weather favored the nuptial flight. The alates took off.
events.flight.noMate: The flight ended without a partner. This founding produced no workers.
events.flight.mating: Mating occurred in the air. The queen is seeking a founding site.
events.flight.landing: The queen landed and began shedding her wings.
events.flight.dealate: Without wings, the queen starts digging the first shelter.
events.founding.initial: Two alates and intact soil. Founding begins after humid and warm conditions.
events.founding.queenLost: Founding ended with the loss of the queen.
events.founding.reserves: Maternal reserves ran out before sustaining the colony.
events.learning.invalid: Invalid policy. Training was not applied.
events.learning.applied: An experimental neural policy was applied to the current colonies. Learning uses local encounters and goals.
events.learning.missing: Train and apply a policy before enabling learning.
events.lesson.initial: Teaching initial condition: prepared colony and brood, without a historical trajectory.
events.traffic.widening: A worker started widening a congested passage.
events.sealing.start: The shelter is ready. The queen collects soil to seal the entrance from inside.
events.sealing.closed: The entrance was sealed with transported soil. The queen begins the claustral phase; pores still allow gas diffusion.
events.sealing.opened: The nanitics removed the plug and carried the soil outside. The entrance now allows foraging.
events.semiclaustral.return: The queen returned to the shelter: {v0} collected food credit(s) available.
events.colony.initial: One queen and one male. The beginning of a colony.
events.queen.conflict: A queen died during a conflict.
events.queen.starvation: The queen died from lack of food.
events.male.cycle: After mating, the male’s cycle ended.
events.food.found: An explorer found a food source.
events.food.added: Food added. Who will find it?
events.plant.added: A new plant begins to grow.
events.predator.nest: The nest offers shelter. Place the predator farther away.
events.soil.occupied: The galleries are occupied. The soil was not disturbed.
events.photoperiod: Photoperiod adjusted to {v0} hours of light per model day.
events.wind: Horizontal wind adjusted to {v0} model units.
events.repose: Experimental angle of repose adjusted to {v0}°.
events.odor.encounter: Ants from different colonies reacted to the odor during an encounter.
events.odor.noAnt: There is no surface ant near the selected point.
events.odor.applied: A foreign odor was applied to ant #{v0}. Observe its next contact.
events.soil.collapse: Soil gave way in a gallery. Workers can remove the loose material.
events.soil.project: A worker started a new excavation front.
events.structure.failure: A ceiling plate lost support and detached. Workers can remove the soil.
events.survival.challenge: An experimental infection challenge was applied to inhabitant #{v0}.
events.brood.laid.maternal: The queen laid {count} eggs using maternal reserves.
events.brood.laid.collected: The queen laid {count} eggs with food brought back by the queen.
events.queen.death.age: The queen died from old age.
events.queen.death.reproduction: The queen died from the end of her reproductive cycle.
events.queen.death.unknown: The queen died from an unclassified cause.
events.comparison: Scenario B: humidity increased by 1 point.
events.material.clay: Relative clay content adjusted to {value}% in the model.
events.material.compaction: Relative compaction adjusted to {value}/100 in the model.
